tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get clean, readable text from a web page — boilerplate, navigation, and ads stripped — so you can work with the actual content. Returns the text plus title, content-type, HTTP status, and length.

tools.name: check_link
tools.description: Is this URL live right now? Returns HTTP status, the redirect chain, final URL, and round-trip latency in milliseconds.

tools.name: check_change
tools.description: Did this web page change since the last time it was checked? Hash-based change detection. First check reports 'new'; later checks report 'changed' or 'unchanged'.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Does this source URL support a given claim? Returns a confidence score, matched terms, and the best supporting excerpt. Heuristic term-overlap — not semantic fact-checking.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
